title: Drax BECCS 2026 environmental-permit air-risk QA controls

sources.title: Consultation opens on Drax Power permit draft decision
Drax Power Limited EPR/VP3530LS/V022 environmental permit draft decision advertisement

facts.source_fact: The Environment Agency's 2026 position was a draft decision to grant a permit variation, not a final permit decision at consultation opening.
The application seeks to vary the existing Drax environmental permit to incorporate carbon capture at the bioenergy plant.
The Environment Agency assesses the variation under the Environmental Permitting Regulations and may grant it only if regulatory and environmental-protection requirements are met.
The proposed capture plant is intended to remove carbon dioxide from waste gases before transport for permanent offshore storage.
The Environment Agency regulates the plant permit but not transport and offshore storage of the captured carbon dioxide.
The operator was required to provide a revised air emissions risk assessment because the earlier information was considered insufficient.
The revised assessment includes potential substances that could be formed in the carbon capture plant.
The draft decision and draft permit were subject to public consultation in 2026.
The Citizen Space consultation opened 27 May 2026 and closed 24 June 2026.
The consultation can take account of relevant environmental regulatory requirements and technical standards.
The consultation can take account of information on local population and sensitive sites.
Consultation evidence can address pollution-control or abatement requirements and monitoring techniques.
The existing environmental permit contains legally binding conditions covering air emissions and monitoring/reporting requirements.
The Environment Agency states carbon capture permit variations are issued only where the operator demonstrates a high level of protection for people and the environment.
The variation application was first submitted in May 2023 and underwent more than one consultation and information request.
The draft decision documentation considers air-dispersion modelling and impacts on human-health and conservation receptors.
The air-risk assessment includes amine chemistry relevant to post-combustion capture emissions.
Potential carbon-capture emissions are assessed against environmental assessment levels or justified derived levels where published values are unavailable.
Draft permit conditions include use of first-year sampled and monitored emissions data to compare actual emissions with assumptions in the application risk assessment.
Where updated assessment indicates unacceptable risks or EAL exceedance risk, remedial action proposals are required for Environment Agency approval.

guard_patterns.handling: Attach Drax permit variation and carbon-capture activity scope.
Carry modelling, monitoring, EAL and remedial-action provenance.
Do not convert site-specific permit evidence into parcel emissions.
